primary_variables.income: nominal average remuneration preferred; December remuneration secondary; SM conversion last resort

allowed_outputs: real values only with explicit deflator
forbidden_claims: nominal income is comparable across years without deflation

2024_transition.required_handling: support .7z and .comt, and apply the official de-para when supplied
2024_transition.fallback: aliases may resolve the schema, but absence of the official de-para remains a high-severity warning

claim_ceiling: Administrative baseline of registered formal employment links in the target occupation; platform use remains unobserved and informal work remains outside the universe.
